_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_spending" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_spending" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_match_keys" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("account_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "buckets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_protected" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_protected" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "income_sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_amount" INTEGER NULL, "schedule_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_day" INTEGER NULL, "schedule_anchor" TEXT NULL, "lands_in_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "split_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deduct_bills_first" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("deduct_bills_first" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "income_payer_keys" ("income_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("income_id", "position"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hold_until_month_end" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("hold_until_month_end" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_allocations" ("profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES split_profiles (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bucket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "basis_points" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "frequency_months" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_day" INTEGER NULL, "next_due_date" TEXT NULL, "paid_from_bucket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payee_account_hint" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "quiet_start_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quiet_end_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "snooze_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cooling_off_threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cooling_off_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL, "check_in_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "check_in_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "app_lock" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("app_lock" IN (0, 1)), "lock_timeout" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'oneMinute', "hide_amounts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hide_amounts" IN (0, 1)), "bill_reminders" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("bill_reminders" IN (0, 1)), "auto_file" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("auto_file" IN (0, 1)), "goal_share_fallback" TEXT NOT NULL, "setup_completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "greeting" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("name"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "help_feedback" ("article_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "helpful" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("helpful" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("article_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "bucket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counter_bucket_id" TEXT NULL, "payday_id" TEXT NULL, "transfer_id" TEXT NULL, "alert_id" TEXT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NULL, "carry_over_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "reverses_entry_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "paydays" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "income_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "snoozes_used" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "snoozed_until" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transfers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payday_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES paydays (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bucket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "proven_amount" INTEGER NULL, "owed_amount" INTEGER NULL, "proven_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transfer_proof_refs" ("transfer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transfers (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("transfer_id", "position"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "held_incomes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "income_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "received_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "alert_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("bucket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_date" TEXT NULL, "celebrated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("bucket_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "check_ins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "counted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_cash" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counted_cash" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_alerts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_text" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NULL, "fee" INTEGER NULL, "counterparty" TEXT NULL, "reference" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NULL, "balance_after" INTEGER NULL, "confidence" REAL NOT NULL, "is_withdrawal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_withdrawal" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bucket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "alert_id" TEXT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NULL, "fee_type" TEXT NULL, "provider" TEXT NULL, "fee_source" TEXT NULL, "parent_transaction_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_lines" ("transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bucket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("transaction_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_withdrawals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cash_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "alert_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchant_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "bucket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "image_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "draft_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planned_purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bucket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "due" TEXT NULL, "repeat_every_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "transaction_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wishes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bucket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ends_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_start" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_amount" INTEGER NULL, "paid_at" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL, "fee_transaction_id" TEXT NULL, "proof_ref" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("bill_id", "cycle_start"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fee_tariffs" ("provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "fee_type" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("provider", "fee_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fee_bands" ("provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "fee_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fee" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "observations" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("provider", "fee_type", "min_amount"));
CREATE INDEX ledger_bucket_time ON ledger_entries (bucket_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX ledger_carry_over ON ledger_entries (carry_over_id)
CREATE INDEX paydays_started ON paydays (started_at)
CREATE INDEX proof_refs_reference ON transfer_proof_refs (reference)
CREATE INDEX alerts_reference ON payment_alerts (source, reference)
CREATE INDEX alerts_received ON payment_alerts (received_at)
CREATE INDEX alerts_status ON payment_alerts (status)
CREATE INDEX transactions_time ON transactions (occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX withdrawals_time ON cash_withdrawals (occurred_at)
